TUN.note: Only says Tunisia has already initiated electronic signature, with no service, date or use named.

facts.fact: La Presse reports a ministry representative, Naoufel Bouzid, describing at a public-expenditure controllers' meeting on 18 November 2025 the national digital strategy as having six axes: digital administration, digital economy and innovation, infrastructure and connectivity, skills, legal framework and regulation, and digital security and data governance; no adoption, text or costing is stated.

TUN.note: No e-commerce or e-transactions law named.
Online procedures and unified portals named as aims, with no service launched or counted.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Open data named as an aim only, no portal or publishing body.
Electronic payments named only as an aim of the strategy.
